summary: Baird Medical Investment Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-domiciled microwave ablation device maker listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses balance sheet, equity rollforward (common and preferred stock, additional paid-in capital, statutory reserve, noncontrolling interests), RSU activity under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan, revenue disaggregation by product line and customer type, and bank loan facilities with Bank of Hangzhou and China CITIC Bank. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms are present; this is a routine periodic earnings-style disclosure.
